exposure: GDM diagnosed based on fasting glycemia
GDM diagnosed based on 2-h oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
outcome: neonatal complications (neonatal hypoglycemia, prolonged jaundice, heart defect)
finding: The change in the criteria for the diagnosis and treatment of GDM resulted in a shift towards diagnosis based on abnormal fasting glycemia and a lower percentage of patients requiring insulin therapy.
mod_finding: The number of caesarean sections and spontaneous deliveries was similar in both groups.
